entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioners submits that the respondents are raising construction of widening of road upto 14 metres on their private land without acquiring the land as per the Land Acquisition Act and without paying any compensation to the petitioners.

In support of his submission he has placed reliance on the report submitted by Revenue Inspector, circle Dhamnod, Tehsil Dharampuri,
District - Dhar wherein he has clearly stated that the land situated at survey No.77/1/2, 77/1/3 is private land of the petitioners.
Considering the aforesaid submissions and taking into consideration the report of the R.I dated 18/5/2023, issue notice to the respondents on payment of P.F within 7 working days by registered mode only with due acknowledgement, returnable within 4 weeks.
Till the next date of hearing, further widening work of the road on the land belonging to the petitioners shall not be carried out.
CC

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Pramod Lokendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124470137/
